items.title: HYGH speeds development and campaigns with ChatGPT Business
items.summary: HYGH speeds up software development and campaign delivery with ChatGPT Business, cutting turnaround times, scaling output, and driving revenue growth.
items.summaryZh: HYGH公司通过采用ChatGPT Business加速了软件开发与营销活动的交付进程。该工具帮助企业显著缩短了周转时间，实现了业务产出的规模化增长，并有效推动了整体营收的提升，展示了大模型在商业实操中的应用成效。
